paragraphs.text: Brass's Tunnel-Grinder was a legendary artifact on Ixalan created by Beckett Brass to dig below its surface.

Brass's Tunnel-Grinder is a large drill created with a similar appearance to the mast of a ship. It can be aimed downwards and is surrounded by a wooden scaffolding with a watch balcony on top for someone to oversee the drilling. Numerous crew hold it straight via ropes onto the surrounding wooden scaffolding. It was used by Beckett Brass and her crew to dig below the surface of Ixalan towards the Core of Paradise . It dug into Tecutlan .
